items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: But he could sing. He could really sing. And a nice guy, too.

ctx.x: Yeah, he was a very remarkable vocalist. He had a tenor voice, and he was a very good singer -- very good. And he had a lot of showmanship about him. But the only thing about him, he was short. You know, he was not tall and manly-looking, the way they like to see vocalists. You know what I mean? They've got to be six feet something tall and one of them things... Well, he wasn't tall or anything. He was too short. But he could sing. He could really sing. And a nice guy, too.
Well, did Russell feature him quite a bit, then?
